subject.title: Feature Request: First-class Projects in Gateway Dashboard (workspace + skill scoping + runtime constraints)

question: Should the first Project MVP introduce durable project metadata plus session/workspace bindings while deferring enforceable tool, skill, and runtime isolation to a separately designed security phase?
rationale: The storage owner, UI hierarchy, protocol contract, and meaning of project-scoped enforcement are product and security choices that cannot be derived safely from existing session or sandbox behavior.

options.title: Split metadata from enforcement
options.body: Ship durable Project records, dashboard switching, and session/workspace bindings first, with clearly informational constraints until enforceable policy is designed.

options.title: Design enforcement in MVP
options.body: Delay implementation until Project records and hard workspace, capability, credential, node, and sandbox enforcement can be specified as one security boundary.

options.title: Extend sessions only
options.body: Decline a new Project object and instead standardize labels, hierarchy, workspace metadata, and shortcuts on existing sessions.

recommendation.title: Split metadata from enforcement
recommendation.body: Ship durable Project records, dashboard switching, and session/workspace bindings first, with clearly informational constraints until enforceable policy is designed.

likelyOwner.reason: The issue discussion and recent history place steipete closest to the cross-cutting dashboard and product-direction decision.
